messages:
oliver: Heads up — customer (ACME) escalated a rerank failure. They pasted the console "copy as cURL" command into their CI and got a 400 with a weird 'scores length mismatch' error. Repro/curl below.

oliver: Problematic curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '\{"query":"best shoe","candidates":["red sneaker","blue loafer"]\}'
```

jessica: Can you paste the exact response body and the header from the server? also which shell/OS is the customer using? :thinking_face:

oliver: Response body is:
```
{"error":"invalid_request","message":"scores length mismatch: got 0, expected 2"}
```
They're on Ubuntu bash in a GitHub Actions runner. The request hits our hosted endpoint.

mike: Two likely issues: the client may have sent an empty "scores" array (server expects explicit scores for candidate weighting) or the payload was mangled by the single-quote + backslash quoting in the console example. In bash the outer single quotes + internal escaped quotes can be fine, but CI copy/paste + YAML can strip backslashes.

mike: Quick repro I ran locally (works):
```
echo '{"query":"best shoe","candidates":["red sneaker","blue loafer"]}' > payload.json
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  --data-binary @payload.json
```
This avoids shell-escaping pitfalls.

jessica: Good call. Customer said they pasted the single-line cURL from the console into a GitHub Actions step `run:` block — GH Actions runs that through a shell and YAML quoting ate the backslashes.

oliver: Also worth noting they didn't include a "scores" key at all — our server treats that as empty and errors when rerank config requires explicit scores. The console docs show an optional scores field but the example payload omits it in one spot. That's confusing.

sara: I can repro the console copy behavior. Our console "Copy as cURL" currently emits single-quoted JSON and escapes double quotes as `\"`, which is fragile in YAML/Actions and on Windows cmd. We should provide variants (bash, powershell, raw file). Filing INF-587 to update docs and add a short note.

sara: INF-587: https://internal.redwood.com/infra/issues/INF-587 — summary: "Rerank docs: clarify scores field + provide shell-safe cURL examples". I'll add a checklist for: copy-as-curl variants, example payload.json, and explicit mention of scores being required for X config.

eng-bot: PR opened by sara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — adds payload.json example and a `--data-binary @payload.json` recommendation.

docs-bot: Docs change deployed to staging.

mike: Action items for eng: add request-side validation to return a friendlier error when scores missing (suggested payload snippet in error), and log whether the body parse had backslashes embedded. I'll file ENG-1201.

oliver: I'll reply to the customer with the safe curl and attach payload.json example. Also recommend they pin the API version while we update docs.

jessica: Thanks all — customer confirmed the `--data-binary @payload.json` fix worked in their GH Actions job. Closing the escalation after docs patch lands. :white_check_mark:
